children: The Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) has accepted bids worth 58.89 billion Indian rupees ($620.79 million) for bonds maturing in three years and one month, three bankers said on Tuesday.
The state-run financial institution will pay an annual coupon of 7.70% on this issue and had invited coupon and commitment bids earlier in the day, they said.
SIDBI did not respond to a Reuters email seeking comment.
